description: Clear a list of up to 50 works for US public-domain status in one call: $0.0075 per work (brief, default) or $0.015 with format "full". For catalogs, reading lists, reprint plans and training-data checks. Calls above the configured cap ($0.25) are refused; split large lists.

countries.description: Also answer for other countries, same price: comma-separated uk, eu, canada, australia, japan, china, india, or all

format.description: brief (default, $0.01): status, date, confidence, one-line reason. full ($0.02): complete reasoning and records.

year.description: Year of first publication (inferred for 1923–1977 books)

name: check_public_domain_batch
title: Check many works at once
